title: Iterate over a bookshelf
description: BookShelf holds a fixed-size array of Books. Implement a BookIterator that traverses the shelf in order via hasNext() and next(). BookShelf.iterator() returns a fresh BookIterator. Callers should be able to iterate without knowing anything about the internal array.
hints: BookIterator tracks the current index and compares it to the number of books
hasNext() returns true while the index is less than the book count
next() returns the book at the current index and advances the index
issues: Exposing the internal array forces callers to know how the shelf is stored
Changing the internal storage structure would break every caller
overallGoal: Use the Iterator pattern to provide sequential access to books without exposing the underlying array.
goals: Define an Iterator interface with hasNext() and next() methods
Implement BookIterator with an index that advances through the book list
Implement iterator() on BookShelf to return a fresh BookIterator starting from the beginning
